minutes.headline: Zoning board continued the 300 Holman Street cease-and-desist appeal to June 12 without ruling.
minutes.summary: The board heard an appeal of the building commissioner's March 2019 cease-and-desist order against events at 300 Holman Street. The owner's attorney, the owner, the building commissioner and many neighbors and residents spoke. The board agreed to use the Mullin rule and continued the hearing so the absent fifth member can review the tapes.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the appeal of the building commissioner's cease-and-desist order on events at 300 Holman Street to June 12 at 7:30, with no ruling.
The board agreed to proceed under the Mullin rule, so the absent fifth member can review the tapes and vote.
The board said it will not rule on the June 8 event, which is up to the building commissioner.
Many neighbors and residents spoke, most urging the board to uphold the commissioner; a former selectman asked for clearer guidelines on multi-day events.

why_it_matters: The outcome will decide whether large, ticketed events can run at a home in a residential neighborhood, and so how noise, parking and traffic are handled on that road and in similar areas.
Because the hearing is open, the ruling could set a precedent for how the town treats events at other private properties.
